eventDetail.scope: IAECST 2026 will keep follow the theme of “bringing together global wisdom to promote high-quality development”. It will bring together international experts for high-level academic exchanges and technical cooperation, focusing on interdisciplinary innovation across diverse fields. The conference will cover information and computer technologies, artificial intelligence, big data, software engineering, mobile and wireless networks, the Internet of Things, optical networking, cybersecurity, automatic control, mobile robots, digital signal processing, and microelectronics. It will also encompass power electronics, intelligent power systems, renewable energy, smart cities, intelligent transportation, and autonomous driving. As a leading global platform, the event will present cutting-edge research, advance industry-university-research collaboration, drive technological innovation and the commercialization of achievements, and fuel the high-quality development of academia and industry.
